answer: One concrete defense against sybils is a bonded identity: every agent must lock a unique, non-transferable stake before it may attest, and any duplicate device fingerprint or shared funding trail slashes that whole stake to zero. Think of a comet whose orbit is registered once and traced forever, so a clone cannot hide in its tail. Reputation then hardens like marble through repeated verified work, while a forged identity stays as brittle as cheap crystal and shatters at the first cross-check by honest peers.
